title: Add GET /health to Go HTTP server
description: A Go HTTP server has a /items endpoint but no /health. Add GET /health returning {"status":"ok"} and a table-driven test for it.

task_spec.prompt: This Go HTTP server has /items but no /health endpoint. Add GET /health to internal/handler/ that returns HTTP 200 JSON {"status":"ok"}. Register it in main.go. Add a test in internal/handler/health_test.go using httptest. All existing tests must still pass.
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `go test ./...` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
